test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Three solid cubes of metal have sides 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm, respectively. They are melted to form a new cube. What is the surface area of this new cube?
solution:
**Given:**

Side of the first cube = 6 cm.

Side of the second cube = 8 cm.

Side of the third cube = 10 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cube = side³

Surface area of a cube = 6 × side²

**Calculation:**

Volume of the first cube = 6³ = 216 cm³

Volume of the second cube = 83&l
